from glom.core import Coalesce, glom
from glom.mutation import assign

target = {'user': {'profile': {'nickname': '', 'name': 'Ada'}}}
name = glom(target, Coalesce('user.profile.alias', 'user.profile.nickname', 'user.profile.name', skip=''))
assign(target, 'user.settings.theme.color', 'blue', missing=dict)
assign(target, 'user.settings.owner', name, missing=dict)

print(name)
print(target)
print(sorted(target['user']['settings'].items()))
